exposure: frequency of consumption of milk and dairy products
frequency of consumption of dried fruits and wheat bread
frequency of use of cosmetic powders
outcome: daily intake of cadmium by newborns
cohort: 70 lactating mothers from Rabat, Morocco, providing breast milk samples between the 2nd and 5th day postpartum.
finding: Cadmium levels in breast milk were low overall, but 30% of samples exceeded the WHO recommended level, and several factors were associated with higher cadmium levels.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher cadmium levels in breast milk.
